adjudication.rationale: The diff adds multiple fallback paths that fetch credentials directly by ID via `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: ... } })` without scoping the query to the expected owner/team. In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, if `destination.credentialId` is not found in `this.calendarCredentials`, it loads `credentialFromDB` by ID only and then uses it to call `createEvent(...)`. Similarly in `EventManager.updateAllCalendarEvents`, if a reference’s `credentialId` isn’t found in `this.calendarCredentials`, it loads `credentialFromDB` by ID only and then calls `updateEvent(...)`. In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, if `credentialId` isn’t found in `bookingToDelete.user.credentials`, it also loads `foundCalendarCredential` by ID only and uses it for `deleteEvent(...)`. These new DB lookups remove the implicit ownership constraint provided by searching within user/team credential sets and can enable use of an arbitrary credential if an attacker can influence `credentialId` in destinationCalendar or booking references.
